post.title: Thanksgiving in Mammoth Lakes with kids
post.hook: Thanksgiving in the mountains, 5 hours from LA

slides.big: Thanksgiving in the mountains, 5 hours from LA
slides.sub: Mammoth Lakes with kids · Nov 25 to 29
slides.pip: Built on what's open Thanksgiving week, not ski lessons.

slides.label: Wed Nov 25 · the drive up 395
slides.dates: Granite arches below the Sierra, west of Lone Pine
pips: There's a porta potty at the Mobius Arch trailhead.
Lunch in Bishop: Schat's, home of Sheepherder Bread since 1938.

slides.label: Thu Nov 26 · Thanksgiving
slides.dates: Woolly's Tube Park · daily Nov 20 to 29, weather permitting
pips: Tube riders must be 42 inches or taller.

slides.label: Fri Nov 27 · summit and lights
slides.dates: Panorama Gondola · daily from Nov 13, weather permitting
pips: Two kids 12 and under ride free with each paying adult.
Village tree lighting: Santa and Woolly light it at 8. Free.

slides.label: Sat Nov 28 · a slow day
slides.dates: Bird and the Biscuit · the inn's pool · Rock 'n' Bowl
pips: Ski lessons only if beginner terrain opens: check the report.
The inn's heated pool and hot tubs run 8 AM to 10 PM.

slides.label: Sun Nov 29 · the drive home
slides.dates: National Historic Site · on US-395 near Independence
pips: Its visitor center opens Fri to Mon: that's why it's Sunday.
Block 14's rebuilt barracks are open daily, 9 to 4:15.

slides.label: The route
slides.pip: About 5 hours without stops. Carry chains in winter.

slides.label: Where we'd stay
lines: Across from Main Lodge, steps from ski school and the gondola.
Heated pool and hot tubs, 8 AM to 10 PM, and a game room.
Thanksgiving dinner is upstairs at Mountainside.
slides.note: Editorial picks. Nobody paid to be here.
slides.pip: Rather cook the turkey? The Village Lodge has condos with kitchens.

items: On Nov 9, 3 of 181 trails were open, with no beginner terrain.
The Village Gondola usually runs mid-December to mid-April.
Tioga Pass to Yosemite closes with the first big snow, usually in November.

sources: Mammoth Mountain: Discover ('approximately 5 hours north of Los Angeles')
Mammoth Mountain: Mountain Report (Mon Nov 9, 2026: 3 of 181 trails, no beginner terrain; Village Gondola, Woolly's and Tamarack closed that day)
Mammoth Mountain: Woolly's Tube Park (scheduled daily Nov 20-29, 2026, weather and conditions permitting; riders 42 inches and up; free Red Line shuttle every 20 min)
Mammoth Mountain: Scenic Gondola Rides (summit 11,053 ft; daily from Nov 13, 2026, weather permitting; up to two kids 12 and under free per paying adult)
Mammoth Mountain: Thanksgiving Dinners, Nov 26, 2026 (Mountainside Bar & Grill seatings 2:30, 5:00 and 7:30 PM; carving stations)
Mammoth Mountain: Holiday Tree Lighting in The Village, Fri Nov 27, 2026, 6-8:30 PM, free; Santa and Woolly light the tree at 8 PM
Mammoth Mountain FAQ: ski school for kids 3+ and potty-trained; kids 4 and under ski free with a ticket
Mammoth Mountain: Lodging (the Village Gondola 'typically operates from mid-December through mid-April')
Mammoth Mountain Inn, 10400 Minaret Rd: across from Main Lodge; heated pool and hot tubs 8 AM-10 PM; game room; check-in 4 PM
The Village Lodge: studios to 3-bedroom condos with full kitchens, heated pool, game room
Visit Mammoth: road conditions (Lakes Basin road and Hwy 203 past Main Lodge closed for winter; carry chains)
NPS Yosemite: Tioga Road closes due to snow, usually from sometime in November through late May or early June
NPS Manzanar: visitor center Fri-Mon 9-4:30, closed Tue-Thu; grounds sunrise to sunset; Block 14 daily 9-4:15
BLM: Alabama Hills National Scenic Area (west of Lone Pine via Whitney Portal Rd and Movie Rd; porta potty at the Mobius Arch trailhead)
Erick Schat's Bakkery, Bishop (Original Sheepherder Bread, 1938; sandwich bar)
Visit Mammoth: Bird and the Biscuit (closed Wednesdays; Sat 8 AM-8 PM)
Visit Mammoth: Mammoth Rock 'N' Bowl (opens 4 PM)
OSRM route on OpenStreetMap data: LA to Alabama Hills 213 mi, to Bishop 62 mi, to Mammoth Lakes 43 mi (computed Nov 10, 2026)
